record.reason: Primary abstract: The efficiency of a datacenter rests on its control plane policies. Designing these policies is increasingly hard: the hardware-software stack grows fast, the design space is vast and interdependent, and prototyping a single policy takes months. Agentic AI pro Agentic generation of datacenter control policies is not inference-serving optimization.
record.title: AtumAI: A Principled Framework for Agentic Generation of Datacenter Control-Plane Policies
